name: T HEAL Capsule 15's
introduction:
Introduction About T HEAL CAPSULE

T Heal Capsule is used to manage tendinopathy and tendon injuries, also used to reduce pain and swelling of the tendon and promotes fast regeneration and repair of damaged tendons. It contains collagen type 1, mucopolysaccharides and vitamin C as active ingredients.  

Mucopolysaccharides binds the fibre together while also providing flexibility, stretching and bending qualities, as well as reliability. Collagen type 1 stimulates collagen synthesis, which may aid in the repair of tendons and increase mechanical strength. Vitamin C contains anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and it also aids in collagen formation and tendon repairing.    

Always take T Heal Capsule as advised by the doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not chew or open the contents of the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women or having any medical condition consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

How BECOSULES CAPSULE Works
How Becosules Helps with Vitamin B Deficiency:

Becosules capsules are specially formulated to address vitamin B deficiency, which can cause fatigue, weakness, and poor metabolism. Packed with essential B-complex vitamins such as B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B9, and B12, Becosules replenishes your body’s vitamin levels, ensuring proper energy production, red blood cell formation, and nervous system health. Regular intake of Becosules helps prevent symptoms associated with vitamin B deficiency, promoting overall well-being.

The Role of Becosules in Managing Fatigue and Weakness:

Fatigue and weakness are common symptoms of vitamin B deficiency, and Becosules capsules offer an effective solution. By supporting the breakdown of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins into energy, B-complex vitamins in Becosules help combat tiredness and restore vitality. Regular supplementation with Becosules improves energy metabolism, making it an ideal choice for those experiencing physical or mental exhaustion.

How Becosules Capsules Boost Immunity and Energy:

Becosules capsules enhance immunity and energy levels with the help of vitamins B-complex, C, and other essential nutrients. Vitamin B-complex supports energy production, while vitamin C acts as an antioxidant, strengthening the immune system and protecting the body from infections. Taking Becosules daily ensures optimal nutrient levels, helping you stay energized and healthy.

How Becosules Supports Hair Growth and Reduces Hair Loss:

Becosules capsules are a reliable supplement for improving hair health. Biotin (Vitamin B7) in Becosules stimulates hair growth and strengthens hair strands, while other B-complex vitamins nourish hair follicles and reduce hair thinning. Additionally, vitamin C improves scalp health by supporting collagen production. Incorporating Becosules into your routine promotes thicker, healthier hair and helps control hair loss.

introduction:
Introduction About ANTOXID CAPSULE

Antoxid Capsule is a nutritional supplement used to meet up the nutritional requirements in the body. It contains beta carotene, zinc, selenium, manganese and copper as active ingredients that help in the normal growth and functioning of the body.

Beta carotene helps to build up proteins and has antioxidant properties that help repair damaged tissues in the body. It also protects the body against the immune system, heart, eye and skin diseases, cancers etc.

Manganese is involved in many chemical processes like the processing of cholesterol, carbohydrates, and protein, and it might also be involved in bone formation. Copper has an important role in the production of red blood cells, absorption of iron, and activation of the immune system.

Selenium helps to reduce skin damage due to UV exposure. Zinc plays a key role in skin health, immune function, and cell growth and may protect against acne, inflammation, and other conditions.

Take Antoxid Capsule exactly as advised by the doctor. Inform your doctor if you are taking any other medicines or dietary supplements, are suffering from any illness, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About FOLLIHAIR NEW GLUTEN FREE TABLET

Follihair New Gluten-Free Tablet is scientifically formulated with multivitamin, multimineral, essential amino acids and botanical extracts to support hair strength, volume and scalp health. Also, it helps to nourish hair from the root level. This formulation is ideal for individuals who are experiencing hair thinning, excessive hair fall, dull or brittle hair or those who need additional nutritional support for maintaining healthy hair and scalp.  

The supplement helps promote stronger hair strands, improved hair texture, and reduced breakage by replenishing key nutrients that play a role in hair growth and follicular repair. Biotin enhances keratin synthesis, iron and folic acid improve oxygen and nutrient delivery to the scalp, while amino acids support the structural integrity of hair proteins. Regular intake of Follihair New Gluten-Free Tablet can also help in managing hair concerns caused by nutrient deficiencies, stress, or environmental damage.

Take one tablet daily or as directed by your doctor, preferably after meals with a glass of water. Avoid taking it on an empty stomach to prevent mild digestive discomfort. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Consistency is key take it at the same time each day to ensure a steady supply of nutrients to your hair and scalp.

Before taking Follihair New Gluten-Free Tablet, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have medical conditions such as kidney, liver, or metabolic disorders. This supplement should be used with caution in people with known allergies to vitamins or amino acids. It is generally well tolerated, but some may experience mild side effects such as nausea, stomach upset, headache, or skin irritation. If any unusual or persistent symptoms occur, discontinue use and consult your healthcare provider. Store in a cool, dry place away from moisture and direct sunlight.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

SUPER D3 60000IU CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

SUPER D3 60000IU CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. SUPER D3 60000IU CAPSULE can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET

FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET is a combination of L-Methylfolate, Methylcobalamin, and Pyridoxal Phosphate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. It is used to manage endothelial dysfunction (large blood vessels on the heart's surface narrow instead of widening) or hyperhomocysteinemia (high levels of an amino acid called homocysteine) in patients who present with lower extremity ulceration.

FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET can also be used to promote optimum health and protect nerve cells in diabetic peripheral neuropathy. Diabetic neuropathy is nerve damage that occurs over time because of high sugar and fat levels in the blood due to diabetes. Symptoms depend on the type of neuropathy, such as pain and numbness in your feet or problems with organ functions like those of your heart and bladder.

Avoid smoking and drinking during management with FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET. FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET has not been proven safe or effective in children, so consult your doctor before using it.

Before taking FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any other conditions or if you are taking any medicines. In pregnant and breastfeeding women, FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET should be used with caution.

The most common side effects of taking FOLINEXT GOLD TABLET are allergic reactions, acne, skin reactions, light sensitivity, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, mild diarrhea, tingling or pricking sensation, sleepiness, headaches, polycythemia vera (a type of blood cancer), itching, temporary skin rash accompanied by fever, and swelling of the entire body. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or if your symptoms worsen.

How REMYLIN D 1000IU TABLET Works

Methylcobalamin plays a crucial role in nerve function and regeneration by promoting the synthesis of myelin, a protective covering around nerves. Alpha Lipoic Acid acts as a potent antioxidant, combating oxidative stress linked to nerve damage. Vitamins B6 and Folic Acid help enhance nerve conduction and metabolic function, while Vitamin D3 assists in calcium absorption and bone health.

Neuroprotective Effects of REMYLIN D Components

REMYLIN D 1000IU Tablet contains key components that provide strong neuroprotective effects through multiple mechanisms:

Methylcobalamin (Vitamin B12): Crucial for nerve repair, this active form of B12 promotes regeneration of damaged neurons and myelin sheath formation, which insulates nerves and enhances signal conduction. It also supports red blood cell formation, combating anemia-related fatigue and improving oxygen delivery to nerve tissues
Alpha Lipoic Acid: A powerful antioxidant that helps neutralize free radicals and reduces oxidative stress, a major contributor to nerve damage, especially in diabetic neuropathy. By protecting nerve cells from oxidative injury, it helps slow the progression of neuropathic symptoms and provides pain relief
Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6): Supports the synthesis of neurotransmitters essential for nerve signal transmission and aids in metabolic processes important for nerve health. It also contributes to nerve rejuvenation and repair
Folic Acid (Vitamin B9): Enhances nerve conduction velocity and supports DNA synthesis and repair within nerve cells, further aiding neuroregeneration
Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3): Facilitates nerve growth factor production, promoting nerve development and survival. It also regulates calcium metabolism, which is vital for neuromuscular functions and bone health.

Ginseng and zinc provide antioxidant benefits that help neutralize free radicals. This reduces oxidative damage at the cellular level and supports immune function. The antioxidant components maintain cellular integrity and promote overall biological balance.

Immune and Cognitive Support: Ingredient Actions Explained

Zinc and copper enhance immune responses, contributing to faster recovery and protection against potential health challenges. Ginseng boosts cognitive alertness and stamina. The combined action of vitamins and minerals ensures sustained mental and physical wellness.

Folic Acid and Methylcobalamin: Their Biological Functions

Folic acid plays a key role in cell division and DNA synthesis, supporting healthy growth and development. Methylcobalamin (vitamin B12) assists in nerve tissue repair and red blood cell formation. Both nutrients are essential for maintaining neurological health and efficient metabolic activity.

introduction:
Introduction About D RISE 2000IU SOFTGEL

D RISE 2000IU SOFTGEL contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

D RISE 2000IU SOFTGEL is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking D RISE 2000IU SOFTGEL, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

D RISE 2000IU SOFTGEL should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. D RISE 2000IU SOFTGEL can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking D RISE 2000IU SOFTGEL, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone)

Glucocorticosteroids Ex. hydrocortisone or prednisolone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

Collagen peptide enhances hair regrowth by increasing the stimulation of hair growth factor and decreasing the enzymes responsible for inhibiting hair growth. Patients with kidney disease should use Meganeuron OD Plus with caution. Vitamin B12 buildup, causing tingling or nerve-related issues

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
There is limited clinical data on the safety of Meganeuron OD Plus during pregnancy.
Folic acid and Methylcobalamin are essential for fetal neural development, but excessive intake can lead to imbalances.
Consult your doctor before use to ensure appropriate dosage and safety.
Breastfeeding
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
There is limited clinical data on the safety of Meganeuron OD Plus during lactation. Therefore, consult your doctor before use to ensure appropriate dosage and safety.
Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION
Some users may experience dizziness, drowsiness, or fatigue after taking Meganeuron OD Plus.
If you experience these symptoms, avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you feel normal.
Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
Alcohol can interfere with the absorption of B vitamins and may reduce the effectiveness of Meganeuron OD Plus.
Chronic alcohol consumption may increase the risk of vitamin B12 deficiency, making supplementation necessary.
Limit or avoid alcohol while taking this supplement.
Kidney
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
Patients with kidney disease may experience difficulty excreating excess methylcobalamin and alpha-lipoic acid, leading to toxicity.
Dose adjustments may be required in individuals with kidney dysfunction—consult a doctor before use.
Liver
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
In liver disease, metabolism of certain vitamins may be impaired.
Dose adjustments may be required in individuals with liver dysfunction—consult a doctor before use.
Allergy

Dose adjustments may be required in individuals with kidney or liver dysfunction—consult a doctor before use.

Lungs
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
While no direct contraindications exist, individuals with pre-existing respiratory conditions should consult their doctor before use.
Heart Disease
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
While no direct contraindications exist, individuals with pre-existing cardiovascular conditions should consult their doctor before use.
Certain B vitamins, when taken in excess, may influence homocysteine levels, which are linked to cardiovascular health.
Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
The safety of Meganeuron OD Plus in children is not well studied.
Use only under pediatric supervision if prescribed for nutritional deficiencies or nerve health issues.
Use In Geriatrics
MONITORING REQUIRED
Elderly individuals are more prone to vitamin B12 deficiency and may benefit from this supplement.
Regular monitoring is advised to prevent overdose and ensure safe supplementation.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ME D3 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Isoniazid, amino-salicylic acid, rifampicin (medicines used to manage tuberculosis)
Oral contraceptives (medicines used to manage pregnancy) (Ex. oestradiol valerate)
Levodopa (a medicine used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Penicillamine, neomycin, chloramphenicol, and co-trimoxazole (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Colchicine (used for the management of gout)
Methotrexate (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and cancer)
Medicines used to manage peptic ulcers (Ex. cimetidine, omeprazole, and lansoprazole)
Mercaptopurine (a medicine used for the management of leukemia)
Altretamine (a medicine used to manage ovary cancer)
Antiepileptics (medicines used to manage fits) (Ex. phenytoin, phenobarbital, primidone, carbamazepine)
Sulfasalazine (a medicine used to manage ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease)
Ketoconazole (a medicine used for the management of fungal infections)
Mineral oil
Corticosteroids (medicines used for the management of inflammatory conditions)
Vitamin C supplements
Potassium supplements
Thiazide diuretics (used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases) (Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide)
Calcium or phosphate supplements
Paricalcitol (used to manage hypoparathyroidism)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally uses too much of ME D3 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage include loss of appetite, weakness, weight loss, vague aches and stiffness, nausea and vomiting, constipation or diarrhea, polyuria (increased urination), nocturia (frequent urination at night), polydipsia (increased thirst), sweating, headache, somnolence, vertigo, mental retardation, anemia (decreased in red blood cell count) and mild acidosis, hypercalciuria (excess calcium in urine), reversible azotemia (elevation of metabolic products), high blood pressure, nephrocalcinosis (deposition of calcium in the kidneys), generalized vascular calcification (abnormal accumulation of calcium in blood) or irreversible kidney damage which may result in death.

Widespread accumulation of calcium in the heart, blood vessels, renal tubules, and lungs. Bone demineralization (osteoporosis) in adults occurs concomitantly. A decline in the average rate of linear growth and increased mineralization of bones in infants and children (dwarfism) may also occur.

Introduction About CALDIKIND 60K SACHET

CALDIKIND 60K SACHET contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogue. It is used to manage Vitamin D deficiency. This may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D during pregnancy.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

CALDIKIND 60K SACHET is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in the blood, malabsorption syndrome, hypervitaminosis D, renal osteodystrophy (kidney disease weakening the bones) with hyperphosphataemia.

Before taking CALDIKIND 60K SACHET, inform your doctor if you have impaired kidney or liver function, are immobilized due to osteoporosis, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) and hyperlipidemia (high lipid levels).

CALDIKIND 60K SACHET should be used with caution in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects during management with this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCIJOINT D3 CAPSULE

CALCIJOINT D3 CAPSULE contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

CALCIJOINT D3 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking CALCIJOINT D3 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

CALCIJOINT D3 CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. CALCIJOINT D3 CAPSULE can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

Dosage Guidelines

Take one capsule daily or as directed by your healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Dosage may vary based on age, health status, and specific health needs.

Steps for Capsule Administration
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water.
Take at a fixed time daily for consistent levels in your body.

Do not crush, chew, or break the capsule.
Best Time to Take Diavit Plus Capsule

Preferably take the capsule with a meal, such as breakfast or dinner, to improve absorption and minimize any digestive discomfort. Consult your doctor for personalized timing.

Tips for Safe Intake
Follow your healthcare provider's instructions carefully.
Avoid taking additional supplements with similar ingredients.
Inform your doctor of all current medications or supplements.
Dosage for Different Age Groups
Adults: Typically one capsule daily, or as advised by a physician.
Children, pregnant or breastfeeding women, and elderly: Use only under medical supervision.
Consultation Before Use

Consult your healthcare provider before starting this supplement, especially if you have existing medical conditions (like diabetes, kidney or liver disorders), are pregnant or breastfeeding, or are taking other medications.

When to Seek Advice
If you experience any unusual symptoms or side effects.
If your condition does not improve or worsens after a few days of taking the supplement.
Before combining with other supplements or medications.
Prior to any surgery or medical procedures.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of DIAVIT PLUS CAPSULE

Common side effects of DIAVIT PLUS CAPSULE can include mild digestive symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, stomach upset, and abdominal cramps. Some users may also experience headache or loss of appetite. It is important to consult a healthcare provider if any unusual or persistent symptoms occur while taking this supplement.

Uncommon and serious reactions
Rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, or throat, which require immediate medical attention.
Other uncommon issues can include nervous system disorders or significant changes in urine color.
Patients should discontinue use and consult a doctor if they experience symptoms such as difficulty breathing, severe dizziness, or swelling

Introduction About Z&B SOFLET

Z&B Soflet is a nutritional supplement used to enhance general immunity and improve general health. It contains vitamins such as folic acid, vitamin B12, vitamin B3 and vitamin B6, minerals such as chromium, selenium, zinc and antioxidants such as lycopene, inositol as active ingredients to improve general immunity.   

Minerals play an important role in improving immunity, zinc has an important role in various immune system processes, improves wound healing, helps in cell division, protein and DNA synthesis. Chromium is important for the metabolism of glucose, insulin and plasma lipids. Selenium is important for the production of special antioxidant proteins called selenoproteins, which are very effective against free radicals (harmful molecules). Inositol improves glucose uptake in tissues and lycopene acts as a potent antioxidant.    

Vitamin B12 is important for the production of DNA and blood pigment haemoglobin. Folic acid is important for the production of healthy red blood cells and DNA. Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) is important for the metabolism of amino acids and glycogen and important for the synthesis of nucleic acids, haemoglobin and messenger chemicals such as serotonin, dopamine, norepinephrine and GABA. Vitamin B3 (nicotinamide) keeps the nervous system and skin healthy. It is also important for fat metabolism in the body to release energy.

Always take Z&B Soflet as advised by the doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not chew or open the contents of the medicine. name: Nuroday D3 Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About NURODAY D3 TABLET

NURODAY D3 TABLET contains Alpha Lipoic Acid, Folic Acid, Methyl cobalamin, Pyridoxine, and Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), which belong to the group of medicines called Antioxidants and Vitamin supplements, respectively. It is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (diabetic nerve damage).

NURODAY D3 TABLET is also used for the management of alcoholic neuropathy (damage to the nerves due to excessive alcohol intake), diabetic retinopathy (diabetic eye disease), peripheral neuropathy (weakness, numbness, and pain usually in the hands and feet), degenerative diseases like Parkinson’s disease (a brain disorder that affects movement) and Alzheimer’s disease (a brain disorder that affects memory and thinking), chronic pain, and vitamin deficiency.

NURODAY D3 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have hypercalcaemia (increased levels of calcium levels in the blood), malabsorption syndrome (difficulty absorbing nutrients from the diet), or hypervitaminosis D (increased level of vitamin D in the body). Consult your doctor before taking it.

NURODAY D3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney impairment, kidney stones, or heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

NURODAY D3 TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How NURODAY D3 TABLET Works

NURODAY D3 TABLET helps to manage neuropathies and supports the health of the brain, where alpha-lipoic acid, an antioxidant, delays or reverses diabetic neuropathy. Folic acid is useful for enhancing nerve conduction velocity in diabetic neuropathy. Methylcobalamin works by producing a compound called myelin, which covers and protects nerve fibers and helps to rejuvenate the damaged nerves. Pyridoxine is an essential nutrient that is required for the metabolism of lipids, carbohydrates, and proteins. It is also needed for the synthesis of neurotransmitters (chemical messengers), and vitamin D increases the level of nerve growth factor (which helps in the development and survival of nerves) by stimulating its production and managing its depletion.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking NURODAY D3 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Isoniazid, amino-salicylic acid, rifampicin (medicines used to manage tuberculosis)
Oral contraceptives (medicines used to manage pregnancy) (Ex. oestradiol valerate)
Levodopa (a medicine used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Penicillamine, neomycin, chloramphenicol, and co-trimoxazole (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Colchicine (used for the management of gout)
Methotrexate (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and cancer)
Medicines used to manage peptic ulcers (Ex. cimetidine, omeprazole, and lansoprazole)
Mercaptopurine (a medicine used for the management of leukemia)
Altretamine (a medicine used to manage ovary cancer)
Antiepileptics (medicines used to manage fits) (Ex. phenytoin, phenobarbital, primidone, carbamazepine)
Sulfasalazine (a medicine used to manage ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease)
Ketoconazole (a medicine used for the management of fungal infections)
Mineral oil
Corticosteroids (medicines used for the management of inflammatory conditions)
Vitamin C supplements
Potassium supplements
Thiazide diuretics (used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases) (Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide)
Calcium or phosphate supplements
Paricalcitol (used to manage hypoparathyroidism)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally uses too much of NURODAY D3 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage include loss of appetite, weakness, weight loss, vague aches and stiffness, nausea and vomiting, constipation or diarrhea, polyuria (increased urination), nocturia (frequent urination at night), polydipsia (increased thirst), sweating, headache, somnolence, vertigo, mental retardation, anemia (decreased in red blood cell count) and mild acidosis, hypercalciuria (excess calcium in urine), reversible azotemia (elevation of metabolic products), high blood pressure, nephrocalcinosis (deposition of calcium in the kidneys), generalized vascular calcification (abnormal accumulation of calcium in blood) or irreversible kidney damage which may result in death.

Widespread accumulation of calcium in the heart, blood vessels, renal tubules, and lungs. Bone demineralization (osteoporosis) in adults occurs concomitantly. A decline in the average rate of linear growth and increased mineralization of bones in infants and children (dwarfism) may also occur.

VIBRANIA D CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney impairment and kidney stones, heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

VIBRANIA D CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects after taking this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally use too much of VIBRANIA D CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage include loss of appetite, weakness, weight loss, vague aches and stiffness, nausea and vomiting, constipation or diarrhoea, polyuria (increased urination), nocturia (frequent urination at night), polydipsia (increased thirst), sweating, headache, somnolence, vertigo, mental retardation, anaemia (decreased in red blood cell count) and mild acidosis, hypercalciuria (excess calcium in urine), reversible azotemia (elevation of metabolic products), high blood pressure, nephrocalcinosis (deposition of calcium in the kidneys), generalized vascular calcification (abnormal accumulation of calcium in blood) or irreversible kidney damage which may result in death.

Widespread accumulation of calcium in the heart, blood vessels, renal tubules and lungs. Bone demineralization (osteoporosis) in adults occurs concomitantly. Decline in the average rate of linear growth and increased mineralization of bones in infants and children (dwarfism) may also occur.

introduction:
Introduction About BIO D3 STRONG CAPSULE

BIO D3 STRONG CAPSULE is combination of Calcium Carbonate, Elemental magnesium, Elemental zinc, Calcitriol, L Methylfolate, Methylcobalamin, and Vitamin K2-7 which belongs to the group of medicines called Minerals, and Vitamins, respectively. It is used to manage post-menopausal, senile, and steroid induced osteoporosis (weak and brittle bones).

The medicine is also used to manage osteomalacia (soft bones), renal osteodystrophy (complication of kidney disease), and fractures and is also indicated for use to manage hypoparathyroidism in affected individuals.

BIO D3 STRONG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Calcitriol, other vitamin D metabolites (such as alfacalcidol, colecalciferol), and/or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypercalcemia (high calcium levels in blood), and/or metastatic calcification (extra deposits of calcium in your body).

Before taking [GBNKEWYORD], inform your doctor if you are immobilized (due to operation/any other reason), and/or have liver problems (such as non-alcoholic fatty liver disease).

BIO D3 STRONG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elders (aged 65 years and above) after consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking BIO D3 STRONG CAPSULE are hypercalcemia (high calcium levels in blood), headache, skin rash, excess thirst, nausea. abdominal pain, and/or urinary tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

How to use CALCIROL XT TABLET
What is the recommended dosage for CALCIROL XT TABLET?
CALCIROL XT TABLET should be taken as prescribed by a healthcare provider.
It is usually taken once daily with a meal for better calcium absorption.
Avoid exceeding the recommended dose to prevent side effects like hypercalcemia.
How should CALCIROL XT TABLET be taken—with or without food?
Preferably taken with food, as calcium is absorbed better when consumed with meals?.
If taking other supplements or medications, keep a gap of at least 2 hours between CALCIROL XT TABLET and drugs like iron or thyroid medications to prevent interaction.
Can CALCIROL XT TABLET be taken daily?

Yes, CALCIROL XT TABLET can generally be taken daily, but the dosage should be based on your doctor's recommendation. Typically, calcium and vitamin D3 supplements like CALCIROL XT TABLET are taken once or twice daily with meals to enhance absorption. However, it is important not to exceed the recommended daily dosage?.

CALCIROL XT TABLET is usually well tolerated with very minimal side effects like nausea, constipation, or stomach discomfort. In most cases, it does not cause any side effects.

Long-term use of CALCIROL XT TABLET may lead to some side effects, although it is generally considered safe when taken as directed. Natural vs. Supplement Sources of Calcium table

Examples

	

Dairy products (milk, cheese, yogurt), leafy greens (kale, spinach), fish with bones (sardines, salmon), fortified foods (plant-based milk, cereals), tofu, legumes

	

Calcium carbonate, calcium citrate, calcium gluconate, calcium lactate (tablets, chewables, and effervescent forms)




Bioavailability

	

Generally better absorbed due to the presence of other nutrients like vitamin D and magnesium

	

Varies depending on the form; calcium citrate has higher bioavailability, while calcium carbonate requires stomach acid for absorption




Nutrient Synergy

	

Includes other essential nutrients (e.g., vitamin D, magnesium, vitamin K) that assist in calcium absorption and bone health

	

May be limited to just calcium or may require additional supplements (like vitamin D) for proper absorption




Ease of Consumption

	

Requires a varied diet to get adequate amounts; may be harder for those with dietary restrictions (e.g., lactose intolerance, vegans)

	

Convenient for those who have difficulty meeting daily calcium needs through food




Digestive Impact

	

Generally causes no digestive discomfort unless one is lactose intolerant or has allergies

	

Overuse can lead to digestive issues (e.g., constipation, bloating), especially with calcium carbonate




Risk of Excess

	

Hard to consume too much from food sources alone; balanced diet reduces risk

	

Higher risk of overconsumption, especially with supplements, which could lead to kidney stones or other health issues




Cost

	

Generally more cost-effective when consuming a balanced diet

	

May be more expensive depending on the form and brand of the supplement




Long-Term Sustainability

	

Long-term use is safe if part of a balanced, healthy diet

	

Should be monitored and used under healthcare guidance, particularly in large doses

Why Calcium Supplements Are Important After 30?

Calcium supplements are crucial for women over 30 due to changes in bone health and overall wellness. After the age of 30, the body starts to lose more bone mass than it builds, particularly because of hormone changes, such as the drop in estrogen levels during menopause. This can lead to weaker bones and a higher risk of osteoporosis. Calcium, along with vitamin D, plays a vital role in supporting bone density and preventing bone loss.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking UPSURGE D3 60000IU CAPSULE, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone)

 Medicines to control the rate of your heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
 Diuretics (water tablets) (Ex. Bendroflumethiazide)
Calcium supplements
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, isoniazid)
Medicines leading to fat malabsorption (Ex. orlistat, cholestyramine, liquid paraffin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole)
Actinomycin (medicine used to manage some forms of cancer)
Glucocorticosteroids Ex. hydrocortisone or prednisolone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of UPSURGE D3 60000IU CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Signs of overdose include loss of appetite, thirst, nausea, vomiting, constipation, abdominal pain, muscle weakness, tiredness, confusion, having to pass more urine than usual, bone pain, kidney problems and in severe cases it may cause irregular heartbeat, coma or even death.

warnings.details: Health OK Sachet 5gm should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed and recommended by a doctor. The ingredients include vitamins and minerals that may already be present in prenatal supplements, so duplication should be avoided. Your doctor will decide the right dosage to ensure safe nutrition for both mother and baby.

Some nutrients in Health OK Sachet 5gm may pass into breast milk. While it generally contains essential vitamins and minerals, it’s best to use it only under medical advice during breastfeeding. Your doctor can help determine if it’s suitable along with your regular postnatal diet.

Health OK Sachet 5gm is unlikely to affect alertness or coordination. However, if you experience dizziness, headache, or fatigue after consumption, avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you feel normal again.

Individuals with kidney disorders should take Health OK Sachet 5gm cautiously. Some minerals like potassium or magnesium may need dosage adjustment in such cases. Always inform your doctor about any kidney problems before starting this supplement.

People with liver impairment should consult their doctor before using Health OK Sachet 5gm. Certain vitamins and amino acids are metabolized in the liver, and monitoring may be required in severe liver conditions. Use only under medical supervision.

Do not take Health OK Sachet 5gm if you are allergic to any of its ingredients, such as specific vitamins, minerals, or flavouring agents. Stop using the sachet and contact your doctor immediately if you experience itching, rash, swelling, or difficulty in breathing.

If you have heart-related problems such as irregular heartbeat, high blood pressure, or heart failure, consult your doctor before using Health OK Sachet 5gm. Some ingredients, like amino acids, may influence circulation or heart rate. Medical guidance ensures safe and suitable use.
Health OK Sachet 5gm is generally intended for adults. Children or adolescents should use it only under medical recommendation, as their nutritional needs differ from adults.

Elderly individuals can use Health OK Sachet 5gm to maintain strength and vitality, but it should be started under a doctor’s guidance. Dosage and frequency may need adjustment based on overall health, diet, and any existing medical conditions.

name: NEW Folinal Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET

NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET is a combination of L-Methylfolate, Methylcobalamin, and Pyridoxal Phosphate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. It is used to manage endothelial dysfunction (large blood vessels on the heart's surface narrow instead of widening) or hyperhomocysteinemia (high levels of an amino acid called homocysteine) in patients who present with lower extremity ulceration.

NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET can also be used to promote optimum health and protect nerve cells in diabetic peripheral neuropathy. Diabetic neuropathy is nerve damage that occurs over time because of high sugar and fat levels in the blood due to diabetes. Symptoms depend on the type of neuropathy, such as pain and numbness in your feet or problems with organ functions like those of your heart and bladder.

Avoid smoking and drinking during management with NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET. NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET has not been proven safe or effective in children, so consult your doctor before using it.

Before taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any other conditions or if you are taking any medicines. In pregnant and breastfeeding women, NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution.

The most common side effects of taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET are allergic reactions, acne, skin reactions, light sensitivity, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, mild diarrhea, tingling or pricking sensation, sleepiness, headaches, polycythemia vera (a type of blood cancer), itching, temporary skin rash accompanied by fever, and swelling of the entire body. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or if your symptoms worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take other medicines with NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Before taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking, have taken, or might take any other medicine, including prescription, non-prescription, or any herbal medicine, as these might interact with each other and cause serious side effects.

faqs.question: Q: Can I drive a car after taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Activities like driving a car or operating machinery should be done cautiously after taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET, as they require complete mental alertness and motor coordination. Your doctor will tell you about these activities after assessing your response to the medicine.

faqs.question: Q: Does NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET cause vomiting?
faqs.answer: A: Vomiting is a possible side effect of NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET. NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET. In such a case, get adequate rest and drink lots of fluids, especially water. Have small sips if you feel sick. Eat when you feel like it; you do not need to eat or avoid any specific foods. Do not take any medicine for vomiting without asking your doctor. Tell your doctor if you have continuous vomiting.

faqs.question: Q: Can NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET be given to children?
faqs.answer: A: The safety and efficacy of NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET in children have yet to be determined. Your doctor will determine the correct dose or select a suitable alternative management for your child.

faqs.question: Q: What if I forget to take a dose of NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, omit the missed dose if it is almost time for the next one. Do not take the medicine twice to make up for the forgotten dose.

faqs.question: Q: Can NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET be stopped?
faqs.answer: A: Continue taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET until your doctor tells you to stop, unless you experience any unwanted effects, a worsening of your condition, or any new symptoms. Contact your doctor in such a case.

faqs.question: Q: Can NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET be crushed?
faqs.answer: A: No. Do not break, crush, or chew NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET. Simply swallow it whole with a glass of water.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions do I need to follow while taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Patients taking NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET must inform their doctor about their pre-existing conditions. Patients should also let their doctors know if they are pregnant, nursing, or allergic to anything. Consult your doctor if you experience anything different.

faqs.question: Q: Can NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET be taken during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: In pregnant women, NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution. If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking this medicine. Inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant during management with NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET.

faqs.answer: A: NEW FOLINAL PLUS TABLET is used to manage endothelial dysfunction (large blood vessels on the heart's surface narrow instead of widening) or hyperhomocysteinemia (high levels of an amino acid called homocysteine) in patients who present with lower extremity ulceration. It can also be used to promote optimum health and protect nerve cells in diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

introduction:
Introduction About BECOZINC M TABLET

BECOZINC M TABLET contains Alpha Lipoic Acid, Folic Acid, Methyl cobalamin, Pyridoxine, and Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), which belong to the group of medicines called Antioxidants and Vitamin supplements, respectively. It is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (diabetic nerve damage).

BECOZINC M TABLET is also used for the management of alcoholic neuropathy (damage to the nerves due to excessive alcohol intake), diabetic retinopathy (diabetic eye disease), peripheral neuropathy (weakness, numbness, and pain usually in the hands and feet), degenerative diseases like Parkinson’s disease (a brain disorder that affects movement) and Alzheimer’s disease (a brain disorder that affects memory and thinking), chronic pain, and vitamin deficiency.

BECOZINC M TABLET is not recommended for use if you have hypercalcaemia (increased levels of calcium levels in the blood), malabsorption syndrome (difficulty absorbing nutrients from the diet), or hypervitaminosis D (increased level of vitamin D in the body). Consult your doctor before taking it.

BECOZINC M TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney impairment, kidney stones, or heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

BECOZINC M TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How BECOZINC M TABLET Works

BECOZINC M TABLET helps to manage neuropathies and supports the health of the brain, where alpha-lipoic acid, an antioxidant, delays or reverses diabetic neuropathy. Folic acid is useful for enhancing nerve conduction velocity in diabetic neuropathy. Methylcobalamin works by producing a compound called myelin, which covers and protects nerve fibers and helps to rejuvenate the damaged nerves. Pyridoxine is an essential nutrient that is required for the metabolism of lipids, carbohydrates, and proteins. It is also needed for the synthesis of neurotransmitters (chemical messengers), and vitamin D increases the level of nerve growth factor (which helps in the development and survival of nerves) by stimulating its production and managing its depletion.

introduction:
Introduction About QUICOBAL ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS

QUICOBAL ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. QUICOBAL ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is used to manage peripheral neuropathies (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms) and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder that occurs due to abnormal production of red blood cells) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

QUICOBAL ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines. It is also not recommended for use in patients with Leber’s disease (an inherited form of vision loss).

Before taking QUICOBAL ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS, inform your doctor if you are in an occupation of handling mercury and/or have kidney problems (such as renal failure) or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

QUICOBAL ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking QUICOBAL ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS are weakness, headache, back pain, muscle pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BLUVIT D3 GRANULES

Bluvit D3 Orange Flavour No Sugar Granules contain cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), a vital nutrient that supports the body's ability to absorb calcium and phosphorus. This formulation is designed for easy consumption, dissolving quickly in water or milk, with a pleasant orange flavor and no added sugar—making it suitable for individuals looking to maintain healthy vitamin D levels without extra sweetness. Vitamin D3 plays an important role in maintaining bone density, muscle function and overall immune support, especially in situations where dietary intake or sunlight exposure is limited.

This product is ideal for patients who may have low vitamin D levels due to limited sun exposure, dietary restrictions, or certain health conditions like osteoporosis, osteomalacia, or familial hypophosphatemia. It is also commonly recommended for elderly individuals, children, and others who require supplementation under medical guidance to support bone and muscle health. Dosage is typically directed by a healthcare professional based on individual needs, often involving the granules being dissolved in water or milk and consumed once weekly or as advised, preferably after meals to enhance absorption.

When using Bluvit D3 Granules, it is important to follow the prescribed dosage and not exceed the recommended amount to avoid unwanted effects such as hypercalcemia. Patients should inform their healthcare provider if they have liver or kidney diseases, or other conditions like hypercalcemia or kidney stones, as these may require dose adjustments or closer monitoring. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should use this product only under medical supervision since excess vitamin D can affect the fetus or infant; small amounts of vitamin D can pass into breast milk, so monitoring is advised.

Common side effects are generally mild and may include nausea, vomiting, or fatigue if taken in excess. Users should discontinue use and consult their doctor if they experience symptoms of overdose such as loss of appetite, muscle weakness, or irregular heart rhythms. Proper storage involves keeping the granules in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and out of reach of children. Overall, Bluvit D3 Granules provide a convenient and patient-friendly option to support vitamin D intake with a pleasant taste and no added sugar.

mechanismOfAction:
How BLUVIT D3 GRANULES Works
How Bluvit D3 Granules Work in the Body

Bluvit D3 Granules provide cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), a fat-soluble vitamin essential for key physiological functions. After ingestion, Vitamin D3 is converted in the liver to 25-hydroxyvitamin D and then in the kidneys to its active form, 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D. This active form helps regulate calcium and phosphorus levels in the bloodstream by increasing their absorption in the intestines and reducing their loss through the kidneys. By maintaining these mineral balances, Bluvit D3 Granules support healthy bone formation, muscle function, and overall metabolic processes.

How does vitamin D3 help absorb calcium and phosphorus

Vitamin D3 in Bluvit enhances intestinal absorption of calcium and phosphorus, two minerals critical for skeletal health. The active form of vitamin D binds to receptors in the intestinal lining, promoting the production of proteins that facilitate calcium and phosphorus transport from food into the bloodstream. This action ensures sufficient mineral availability for bone mineralization and maintenance of tooth structure. Adequate vitamin D levels also help regulate renal reabsorption, minimizing mineral loss, thus supporting stable bone and mineral metabolism.

What role does Bluvit D3 play in bone and muscle health

Bluvit D3 Granules aid bone and muscle health by ensuring adequate vitamin D3 availability to promote calcium and phosphorus absorption, crucial for strong bones and teeth. Maintaining optimal vitamin D levels helps sustain bone density and muscle strength, reducing the risk of weakness and fractures, especially in populations such as elderly individuals, growing children, or those with limited sun exposure. Additionally, vitamin D contributes to muscle fiber function, enhancing physical capacity and reducing muscle pain or cramps associated with deficiency.

How does vitamin D3 contribute to immune support

Vitamin D3 supports immune health by modulating the immune system's response and enhancing its ability to defend against infections. It stimulates the production of antimicrobial peptides, molecules that act as natural antibiotics protecting against pathogens. Vitamin D3 also regulates inflammatory processes, helping maintain immune balance and preventing overactive immune responses. Supplementation with Bluvit D3 Granules helps maintain vitamin D levels that are associated with better immune resilience, particularly in individuals at risk of deficiency.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking DETRIOL SUGAR FREE 600000IU ORAL SOLUTION, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Glucocorticosteroids (Ex. dexamethasone or prednisolone) used to manage inflammation

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DETRIOL SUGAR FREE 600000IU ORAL SOLUTION, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose include damage of soft tissues and kidney, lack of appetite, thirst, nausea, vomiting, constipation, abdominal pain, muscle weakness, fatigue, mental disturbances, increased urination, bone pain and in severe cases may result in coma and death.

introduction:
Introduction About HOMOCHEK CAPSULE

Homochek Capsule is a vitamin-rich nutritional supplement designed to help meet the daily requirements of essential B-complex vitamins like methylcobalamin (Vitamin B12), folic acid (Vitamin B9) and pyridoxine (Vitamin B6). These nutrients play a key role in maintaining healthy nerve function, supporting red blood cell formation, and improving overall energy levels. Homochek is commonly used in individuals with vitamin B12 or folate deficiencies, people with diabetic neuropathy, or those experiencing fatigue, numbness, or tingling in the limbs due to nerve imbalances.

It is particularly suited for individuals at risk of B-vitamin deficiency, such as vegetarians, elderly patients, people with diabetes, chronic alcohol users, or those on long-term medications like metformin or anticonvulsants. Homochek may also benefit patients recovering from illness or surgery and those with high physical or mental stress levels. The combination of active ingredients is formulated to promote nerve regeneration, reduce neuropathic discomfort, and support cognitive and cardiovascular well-being.

The recommended dose is usually one capsule daily, taken with or after meals, as advised by a healthcare provider. To get the most benefit, take it at a consistent time each day. Avoid taking it with tea, coffee, or high-fibre foods, which may interfere with absorption. Inform your doctor if you are on other medications, as some drug interactions may occur (e.g., with phenytoin, levodopa, or methotrexate). Do not exceed the recommended dose without medical advice.

Homochek Capsule is generally safe but may cause mild side effects like nausea, bloating, or headache in some users. It can be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding under medical supervision, especially when additional folic acid and B12 are needed. However, always consult your doctor before use in these cases. Store the capsule in a cool, dry place and keep it out of reach of children. Regular monitoring of vitamin levels may be advised during prolonged use.

mechanismOfAction:
How HOMOCHEK CAPSULE Works
Mechanism of Action of Homochek

The mechanism of action of Homochek capsule is based on its three key vitamin components—methylcobalamin (vitamin B12), folic acid (vitamin B9), and pyridoxine (vitamin B6)—which work synergistically to support crucial physiological functions:

Methylcobalamin (Vitamin B12): Acts as a cofactor for the enzyme methionine synthase, facilitating the transfer of methyl groups to convert homocysteine into methionine. This reduces homocysteine levels, which helps prevent cardiovascular and neurological damage. It also supports normal red blood cell production by promoting nucleic acid synthesis and maturation of erythrocytes, thereby preventing megaloblastic anemia. Additionally, it supports proper functioning of the brain and nervous system.

Folic Acid (Vitamin B9): Essential for DNA synthesis and repair, folic acid supports the formation and maintenance of new cells, especially rapidly dividing cells such as red blood cells. It works together with vitamin B12 to lower homocysteine levels by remethylation, which helps reduce cardiovascular risk and supports healthy blood formation.

Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6): Involved in protein metabolism and acts as a coenzyme in the conversion of homocysteine to cystathionine via the transsulfuration pathway, further lowering homocysteine concentrations. It also plays a role in neurotransmitter synthesis (e.g., serotonin and dopamine) and supports nerve health and immune function.

How Does Vitamin B12 Function in the Body

Vitamin B12 plays a vital role in maintaining the health of nerves and blood cells. It is essential for DNA synthesis, supports brain function, and helps in the formation of red blood cells. A lack of B12 can lead to fatigue, nerve issues, and megaloblastic anaemia. In Homochek capsule, vitamin B12 complements iron and folic acid to support complete blood health and energy levels.

NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET is also used for the management of alcoholic neuropathy (damage to the nerves due to excessive alcohol intake), diabetic retinopathy (diabetic eye disease), peripheral neuropathy (weakness, numbness, and pain usually in the hands and feet), degenerative diseases like Parkinson’s disease (a brain disorder that affects movement) and Alzheimer’s disease (a brain disorder that affects memory and thinking), chronic pain, and vitamin deficiency.

NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET is not recommended for use if you have hypercalcaemia (increased levels of calcium levels in the blood), malabsorption syndrome (difficulty absorbing nutrients from the diet), or hypervitaminosis D (increased level of vitamin D in the body). NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney impairment, kidney stones, or heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects after taking this medicine.

How NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET Works

NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET helps to manage neuropathies and supports the health of the brain, where alpha-lipoic acid, an antioxidant, delays or reverses diabetic neuropathy. interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Isoniazid, amino-salicylic acid, rifampicin (medicines used to manage tuberculosis)
Oral contraceptives (medicines used to manage pregnancy) (Ex. oestradiol valerate)
Levodopa (a medicine used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Penicillamine, neomycin, chloramphenicol, and co-trimoxazole (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Colchicine (used for the management of gout)
Methotrexate (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and cancer)
Medicines used to manage peptic ulcers (Ex. cimetidine, omeprazole, and lansoprazole)
Mercaptopurine (a medicine used for the management of leukemia)
Altretamine (a medicine used to manage ovary cancer)
Antiepileptics (medicines used to manage fits) (Ex. phenytoin, phenobarbital, primidone, carbamazepine)
Sulfasalazine (a medicine used to manage ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease)
Ketoconazole (a medicine used for the management of fungal infections)
Mineral oil
Corticosteroids (medicines used for the management of inflammatory conditions)
Vitamin C supplements
Potassium supplements
Thiazide diuretics (used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases) (Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide)
Calcium or phosphate supplements
Paricalcitol (used to manage hypoparathyroidism)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally uses too much of NEUROTRAT LM NEW TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage include loss of appetite, weakness, weight loss, vague aches and stiffness, nausea and vomiting, constipation or diarrhea, polyuria (increased urination), nocturia (frequent urination at night), polydipsia (increased thirst), sweating, headache, somnolence, vertigo, mental retardation, anemia (decreased in red blood cell count) and mild acidosis, hypercalciuria (excess calcium in urine), reversible azotemia (elevation of metabolic products), high blood pressure, nephrocalcinosis (deposition of calcium in the kidneys), generalized vascular calcification (abnormal accumulation of calcium in blood) or irreversible kidney damage which may result in death.

Widespread accumulation of calcium in the heart, blood vessels, renal tubules, and lungs. Bone demineralization (osteoporosis) in adults occurs concomitantly. A decline in the average rate of linear growth and increased mineralization of bones in infants and children (dwarfism) may also occur.

Amino acids like l-histidine, l-lysine and glycine helps in increasing iron absorption within the body and manages iron loss via the gut. 

Zinc ascorbate boosts your immunity and protects you from getting infected easily. Studies have shown that zinc ascorbate also helps in better absorption of iron, especially in people with gut disorders or kidney disorders. They also reduce the gut problems caused by iron.

introduction:
Introduction About NUROKIND INJECTION

NUROKIND INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. NUROKIND INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

NUROKIND INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

NUROKIND INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving NUROKIND INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

NUROKIND INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving NUROKIND INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How GLIAREN D TABLET Works

GLIAREN D TABLET helps to manage neuropathies and supports the health of the brain, where alpha-lipoic acid, an antioxidant, delays or reverses diabetic neuropathy. Folic acid is useful for enhancing nerve conduction velocity in diabetic neuropathy. Methylcobalamin works by producing a compound called myelin, which covers and protects nerve fibers and helps to rejuvenate the damaged nerves. Pyridoxine is an essential nutrient that is required for the metabolism of lipids, carbohydrates, and proteins. It is also needed for the synthesis of neurotransmitters (chemical messengers), and vitamin D increases the level of nerve growth factor (which helps in the development and survival of nerves) by stimulating its production and managing its depletion.
usageDetails:

GLIAREN D TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking GLIAREN D TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking GLIAREN D TABLET, as it impairs the absorption of Vitamin B12 from the stomach and intestine.
GLIAREN D TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney impairment and kidney stones. Consult your doctor before taking GLIAREN D TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking GLIAREN D TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Isoniazid, amino-salicylic acid, rifampicin (medicines used to manage tuberculosis)
Oral contraceptives (medicines used to manage pregnancy) (Ex. oestradiol valerate)
Levodopa (a medicine used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Penicillamine, neomycin, chloramphenicol, and co-trimoxazole (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Colchicine (used for the management of gout)
Methotrexate (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and cancer)
Medicines used to manage peptic ulcers (Ex. cimetidine, omeprazole, and lansoprazole)
Mercaptopurine (a medicine used for the management of leukemia)
Altretamine (a medicine used to manage ovary cancer)
Antiepileptics (medicines used to manage fits) (Ex. phenytoin, phenobarbital, primidone, carbamazepine)
Sulfasalazine (a medicine used to manage ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease)
Ketoconazole (a medicine used for the management of fungal infections)
Mineral oil
Corticosteroids (medicines used for the management of inflammatory conditions)
Vitamin C supplements
Potassium supplements
Thiazide diuretics (used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases) (Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide)
Calcium or phosphate supplements
Paricalcitol (used to manage hypoparathyroidism)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally uses too much of GLIAREN D TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage include loss of appetite, weakness, weight loss, vague aches and stiffness, nausea and vomiting, constipation or diarrhea, polyuria (increased urination), nocturia (frequent urination at night), polydipsia (increased thirst), sweating, headache, somnolence, vertigo, mental retardation, anemia (decreased in red blood cell count) and mild acidosis, hypercalciuria (excess calcium in urine), reversible azotemia (elevation of metabolic products), high blood pressure, nephrocalcinosis (deposition of calcium in the kidneys), generalized vascular calcification (abnormal accumulation of calcium in blood) or irreversible kidney damage which may result in death.

Widespread accumulation of calcium in the heart, blood vessels, renal tubules, and lungs. Bone demineralization (osteoporosis) in adults occurs concomitantly. A decline in the average rate of linear growth and increased mineralization of bones in infants and children (dwarfism) may also occur.

name: AFFOCAL CT Softgel 10's
introduction:
Introduction About AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL

AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL is a combination of Calcitriol, Calcium carbonate, and Zinc sulphate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nutritional supplements. It is used in adults for the management of low blood calcium levels in conditions including chronic renal failure, osteodystrophy (bone pain, joint pain, bone deformation, and fractures due to kidney disease or disturbances in calcium and phosphorus levels), and osteoporosis (bones become weak and brittle as we age).

AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL is also used to manage hypoparathyroidism (changes to parathyroid glands that may decrease the blood calcium too low), rickets or osteomalacia (softening and weakening of bones in children and adults, respectively, due to a lack of adequate vitamin D), after small bowel resection, and psoriasis (a disease in which skin becomes dry with itchy, scaly patches, most commonly on the knees, elbows, trunk, and scalp).

Avoid taking AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL within 2 hours of eating foods rich in oxalic acid (Ex. spinach and rhubarb), phosphate (Ex. brain), or phytic acid (Ex. whole cereals). AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL is not recommended for patients having diseases and/or conditions resulting in hypercalcaemia and/or hypercalciuria (ex. myeloma, bone metastases, primary hyperparathyroidism) and hypervitaminosis D.

AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL should be used with caution in patients with impaired liver function and kidney problems such as nephrolithiasis, nephrocalcinosis, and renal failure.

AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, children, or adolescents unless considered necessary. AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL should be avoided by breastfeeding women. AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The common side effects of AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL are muscle pain, weakness, headache, excessive sleepiness, nausea and vomiting, and dry mouth. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL Works

AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL is a combination of calcitriol that acts as an active form of vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) for the absorption of calcium from the stomach and the functioning of calcium in the body. Calcium carbonate works as a nutritional supplement to directly increase the calcium stores within the body, and zinc sulphate counteracts the diminished calcitriol response to arrest bone loss. All these actions together will increase the levels of calcium, which is useful in managing bone disorders and disturbances in the parathyroid glands.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions: 

Before taking AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage edema and blood pressure [Ex. chlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, hydrochlorothiazide, indapamide, and metolazone]
Medicines used to suppress the immune system [Ex. cortisone, prednisone, and prednisolone]
Digoxin (used in the management of heart problems)
Cholestyramine (a medicine used to lower high cholesterol levels in the blood
Paraffin oil (used to manage constipation)
Levothyroxine (used to manage an underactive thyroid gland)
Medicines used in the management of bacterial infections [Ex. tetracycline, sparfloxacin, ofloxacin, penicillamine, and norfloxacin]
Medicines used to manage epilepsy [Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone]
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

Avoid taking AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL within 2 hours of eating foods rich in oxalic acid (Ex. spinach and rhubarb), phosphate (Ex. bran), or phytic acid (Ex. whole cereals).

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of AFFOCAL CT SOFTGEL, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are nausea, severe vomiting, dehydration, and restlessness.

introduction:
Introduction About ARKACAL D3 60K GRANULES

ARKACAL D3 60K GRANULES contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogue. It is used to manage Vitamin D deficiency. This may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D during pregnancy.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

ARKACAL D3 60K GRANULES is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in the blood, malabsorption syndrome, hypervitaminosis D, renal osteodystrophy (kidney disease weakening the bones) with hyperphosphataemia.

Before taking ARKACAL D3 60K GRANULES, inform your doctor if you have impaired kidney or liver function, are immobilized due to osteoporosis, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) and hyperlipidemia (high lipid levels).

ARKACAL D3 60K GRANULES should be used with caution in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects during management with this medicine.

name: Nurokind OD Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About NUROKIND OD INJECTION

NUROKIND OD INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. NUROKIND OD INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

NUROKIND OD INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

NUROKIND OD INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving NUROKIND OD INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

NUROKIND OD INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving NUROKIND OD INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION

ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone)
Other vitamin D containing medicines including multi-vitamins
 Medicines to control the rate of your heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
 Diuretics (water tablets) (Ex. Bendroflumethiazide)
Calcium supplements
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, isoniazid)
Medicines leading to fat malabsorption (Ex. orlistat, cholestyramine, liquid paraffin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole)
Actinomycin (medicine used to manage some forms of cancer)
Glucocorticosteroids Ex. hydrocortisone or prednisolone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ARACHITOL 6LAC INJECTION, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Signs of overdose include loss of appetite, thirst, nausea, vomiting, constipation, abdominal pain, muscle weakness, tiredness, confusion, having to pass more urine than usual, bone pain, kidney problems and in severe cases it may cause irregular heartbeat, coma or even death.

Caldikind Plus Capsule is a nutritional supplement formulated to support bone, joint, and overall musculoskeletal health.
