This formulation is particularly useful for people at risk of bone weakness, osteoporosis, arthritis, or age-related decline in musculoskeletal strength, as well as those recovering from bone injuries or surgeries.

The supplement helps in maintaining optimal calcium and vitamin D levels, which are essential for bone mineralization, joint flexibility, and nerve function. Mecobalamin and folic acid support nerve health and red blood cell production, while omega-3 fatty acids contribute to joint comfort and cardiovascular wellness. Regular use, in combination with a balanced diet, weight-bearing exercises, and adequate sunlight exposure, helps improve bone strength, overall energy, and musculoskeletal wellness. 

Caldikind Plus Capsule is typically taken once daily, preferably after meals, to maximize absorption and reduce stomach discomfort. Patients should swallow the capsule whole with water and follow their doctor’s prescribed dosage. It is suitable for adults, elderly people, and children under medical supervision, as well as pregnant and breastfeeding women under doctor guidance. Patients are advised to inform their healthcare provider about any existing medical conditions or medications to avoid interactions.

Important precautions include avoiding use in cases of allergy to any ingredient, hypercalcemia, kidney stones, or severe kidney or liver impairment. Common side effects are generally mild and may include nausea, constipation, or stomach discomfort. Seek medical attention if you experience severe symptoms such as excessive thirst, frequent urination, or allergic reactions. Overall, Caldikind Plus Capsule is an effective and safe supplement for maintaining bone health and overall musculoskeletal wellness when used as directed.

Mechanism of Action of Caldikind Plus Capsule

Caldikind Plus Capsule works through a synergistic combination of nutrients to support bone, joint, and overall musculoskeletal health:

Calcium Carbonate – Provides the essential mineral calcium, which is a key component of bone and teeth structure. It helps in bone mineralization, maintaining bone density and strength.

Methylcobalamin (Vitamin B12) and Folic Acid – Support nerve function and aid in the production of red blood cells, which are crucial for overall energy and tissue health.
Boron – Plays a role in bone metabolism, helping the body retain calcium and maintain healthy bones and joints.
Omega-3 Fatty Acids (EPA & DHA) – Contribute to joint flexibility and comfort by supporting anti-inflammatory processes and overall musculoskeletal health.

Overall, the combination of these ingredients in Caldikind Plus Capsule helps strengthen bones, support nerve and joint function, and improve overall musculoskeletal wellness, making it suitable for individuals with calcium or vitamin D deficiency, osteoporosis, arthritis, or age-related bone weakness.

It contains antioxidants, minerals, and vitamins which aids in the formation of myelin sheath (sheath that forms around nerves including brain and spinal cord) and manages damage to the peripheral nerves.

Methylcobalamin is an activated form of vitamin B12 which aids in the replenishment of vitamin B12 (essential for the synthesis of myelin) in the body, thus improving nerve function. Alpha Lipoic acid is an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent which helps to minimize oxidative stress that occurs due to free radicals and inflammation in the nerves. Pyridoxine hydrochloride helps in the synthesis of myelin sheath (protective covering on the nerves) and certain neurotransmitters (chemical messengers that help in nerve conduction) which aids in the improvement of nerve function. Folic acid is a synthetic vitamin which helps to improve nerve function by assisting in the production of mitochondrial cells (responsible for nerve function). Zinc oxide is a mineral that promotes myelination by interacting with myelin base protein (essential for myelination of nerves), thereby improving nerve function.  Chromium picolinate is an antioxidant which helps to manage impaired glycaemic control. Inositol is a carbocyclic sugar that manages structural change and increase nodal remyelination thereby promoting nerve function. Lutein is an antioxidant which helps to improve nerve function.

Take Nervijen D New Capsule as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE

FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE is a combination of L-Methylfolate, Methylcobalamin, and Pyridoxal Phosphate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. It is used to manage endothelial dysfunction (large blood vessels on the heart's surface narrow instead of widening) or hyperhomocysteinemia (high levels of an amino acid called homocysteine) in patients who present with lower extremity ulceration.

FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE can also be used to promote optimum health and protect nerve cells in diabetic peripheral neuropathy. Diabetic neuropathy is nerve damage that occurs over time because of high sugar and fat levels in the blood due to diabetes. Symptoms depend on the type of neuropathy, such as pain and numbness in your feet or problems with organ functions like those of your heart and bladder.

Avoid smoking and drinking during management with FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE. FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE has not been proven safe or effective in children, so consult your doctor before using it.

Before taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any other conditions or if you are taking any medicines. In pregnant and breastfeeding women, FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE should be used with caution.

The most common side effects of taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE are allergic reactions, acne, skin reactions, light sensitivity, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, mild diarrhea, tingling or pricking sensation, sleepiness, headaches, polycythemia vera (a type of blood cancer), itching, temporary skin rash accompanied by fever, and swelling of the entire body. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or if your symptoms worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take other medicines with FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: Before taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking, have taken, or might take any other medicine, including prescription, non-prescription, or any herbal medicine, as these might interact with each other and cause serious side effects.

faqs.question: Q: Can I drive a car after taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: Activities like driving a car or operating machinery should be done cautiously after taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE, as they require complete mental alertness and motor coordination. Your doctor will tell you about these activities after assessing your response to the medicine.

faqs.question: Q: Does FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE cause vomiting?
faqs.answer: A: Vomiting is a possible side effect of FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE. FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE. In such a case, get adequate rest and drink lots of fluids, especially water. Have small sips if you feel sick. Eat when you feel like it; you do not need to eat or avoid any specific foods. Do not take any medicine for vomiting without asking your doctor. Tell your doctor if you have continuous vomiting.

faqs.question: Q: Can FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE be given to children?
faqs.answer: A: The safety and efficacy of FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE in children have yet to be determined. Your doctor will determine the correct dose or select a suitable alternative management for your child.

faqs.question: Q: What if I forget to take a dose of FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, omit the missed dose if it is almost time for the next one. Do not take the medicine twice to make up for the forgotten dose.

faqs.question: Q: Can FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE be stopped?
faqs.answer: A: Continue taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE until your doctor tells you to stop, unless you experience any unwanted effects, a worsening of your condition, or any new symptoms. Contact your doctor in such a case.

faqs.question: Q: Can FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE be crushed?
faqs.answer: A: No. Do not break, crush, or chew FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE. Simply swallow it whole with a glass of water.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions do I need to follow while taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: Patients taking FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE must inform their doctor about their pre-existing conditions. Patients should also let their doctors know if they are pregnant, nursing, or allergic to anything. Consult your doctor if you experience anything different.

faqs.question: Q: Can FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE be taken during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: In pregnant women, FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE should be used with caution. If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking this medicine. Inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant during management with FOLVITE ACTIVE CAPSULE.

It can also be used to promote optimum health and protect nerve cells in diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

introduction:
Introduction About D SOL GRANULE

D SOL GRANULE contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogue. It is used to manage Vitamin D deficiency. This may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D during pregnancy.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

D SOL GRANULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in the blood, malabsorption syndrome, hypervitaminosis D, renal osteodystrophy (kidney disease weakening the bones) with hyperphosphataemia.

Before taking D SOL GRANULE, inform your doctor if you have impaired kidney or liver function, are immobilized due to osteoporosis, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) and hyperlipidemia (high lipid levels).

D SOL GRANULE should be used with caution in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects during management with this medicine.

D SOL GRANULE helps the body to absorb calcium and phosphorus by increasing their absorption from the gut and reducing the amount removed by the kidneys and is a fat-soluble vitamin.

Take D SOL GRANULE as directed by the physician. Pour the contents of the sachet into a glass of water or milk. Stir with a spoon to obtain a pleasant-tasting suspension. Drink immediately. name: GEMCAL DS Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About GEMCAL DS TABLET

GEMCAL DS TABLET is a combination of Calcitriol, Calcium Carbonate, and Menaquinone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Nutritional Supplements. It is used to manage osteoporosis.

Osteoporosis is a condition that causes the thinning and weakening of bones because of the excessive absorption of calcium from the bones. It is characterized by symptoms such as bleeding gums, weak grip strength, brittle fingernails, loss of height, frequent fractures, and neck and back pain.

GEMCAL DS TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to calcitriol or calcium. It is also not recommended for use if you have kidney stones, hypercalcaemia (high blood calcium levels), or evidence of vitamin D toxicity.

GEMCAL DS TABLET should be used with caution in cases of hepatic insufficiency, nephrotic diseases (a kidney disease causing excess protein in your urine), chronic renal failure, and a high tendency to get kidney stones. GEMCAL DS TABLET should also be used with caution in patients undergoing dialysis.

GEMCAL DS TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant women only if necessary. GEMCAL DS TABLET is not recommended to be used by breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children (under 6 years of age) and elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The common side effects associated with the use of GEMCAL DS TABLET are diarrhea, constipation, an upset stomach, and abdominal pain. Contact your doctor or a nearby hospital if any of the conditions worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How GEMCAL DS TABLET Works

GEMCAL DS TABLET helps in managing bone weakening, where calcitriol plays a very important role in aiding the absorption of calcium by acting on certain gut cells to increase the production of calcium transport proteins, whereas calcium carbonate acts by directly increasing the calcium stores in the body.

Vitamin K activates the calcium-binding actions of two proteins (the matrix GLA protein and osteocalcin), which helps in enhancing calcium absorption in the body, thereby increasing bone mass and strength.

introduction:
Introduction About D RISE SACHET

D Rise Sachet 1gm is a convenient, single-dose oral powder containing Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), a nutrient vital for bone strength and calcium regulation. It is often recommended when dietary intake or sun exposure is insufficient to meet the body’s vitamin D requirements. Individuals who spend limited time outdoors, cover their skin, or live in low-sunlight regions may benefit from periodic Vitamin D3 supplementation. The sachet form offers easy mixing in milk or water, making it suitable for adults and seniors alike.

D Rise is commonly used as part of a nutritional plan to support bone density, muscle function, calcium absorption, and immune health. It may be advised for elderly individuals, postmenopausal women, people with limited mobility, or those with low Vitamin D blood levels as detected through lab tests. The high-strength once-a-week or monthly format (60,000 IU) allows for consistent correction and maintenance under professional guidance.

To use, dissolve the full contents of the sachet in a glass of milk or water and consume it immediately after a main meal. Taking D Rise with food that contains healthy fats enhances its absorption, as Vitamin D3 is fat-soluble. Always follow the dosage and frequency as recommended by your healthcare provider typically once weekly for 6–8 weeks or monthly for maintenance, depending on individual needs.

While D Rise Sachet is generally well tolerated, some users may experience minor effects like nausea, constipation, or stomach discomfort. It should be used with caution in individuals with kidney issues, high calcium levels, or those taking other supplements. During pregnancy and breastfeeding, use should be supervised by a doctor to avoid excessive intake. Always inform your doctor about other medicines or health conditions before starting D Rise.

mechanismOfAction:
How D RISE SACHET Works
D Rise Sachet Mechanism of Action

D Rise Sachet 1gm contains Cholecalciferol, a form of Vitamin D3. Once consumed, it undergoes conversion in the body to become biologically active. This active form then supports the regulation of calcium and phosphorus levels nutrients essential for healthy bones, muscles, and nerves.

 How D Rise Sachet is Activated in the Body

After oral intake, Cholecalciferol is absorbed in the intestines and carried to the liver, where it is converted into calcidiol (25-hydroxyvitamin D). This form is then converted in the kidneys into calcitriol, the active hormone. Calcitriol binds to specific receptors in the body and helps regulate mineral balance by increasing the absorption of calcium from the gut.

This multi-step activation is essential to enable vitamin D to function effectively in the body.

 How D Rise Sachet Helps with Calcium Absorption

Vitamin D3 plays a central role in enhancing calcium absorption from the digestive tract. When D Rise Sachet is activated in the body, it stimulates calcium transport proteins in the intestines, allowing more calcium to be absorbed into the bloodstream. This is especially important when dietary intake is not enough or when the body’s natural vitamin D levels are low.

Supporting adequate calcium absorption helps in maintaining healthy bones, teeth, and muscle function.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
There is limited clinical data on the safety of NERVMAX ACTIVE Capsule during pregnancy.
Folic acid and Methylcobalamin are essential for fetal neural development, but excessive intake can lead to imbalances.
Consult your doctor before use to ensure appropriate dosage and safety.
Breastfeeding
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
There is limited clinical data on the safety of NERVMAX ACTIVE Capsule during lactation. Therefore, consult your doctor before use to ensure appropriate dosage and safety.
Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION
Some users may experience dizziness, drowsiness, or fatigue after taking NERVMAX ACTIVE Capsule.
If you experience these symptoms, avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you feel normal.
Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
Alcohol can interfere with the absorption of B vitamins and may reduce the effectiveness of NERVMAX ACTIVE Capsule.
Chronic alcohol consumption may increase the risk of vitamin B12 deficiency, making supplementation necessary.
Limit or avoid alcohol while taking this supplement.
Kidney
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
Patients with kidney disease may experience difficulty excreating excess methylcobalamin and alpha-lipoic acid, leading to toxicity.
Dose adjustments may be required in individuals with kidney dysfunction—consult a doctor before use.
Liver
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
In liver disease, metabolism of certain vitamins may be impaired.
Dose adjustments may be required in individuals with liver dysfunction—consult a doctor before use.
Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED
Do not take NERVMAX ACTIVE Capsule if you are allergic to any ingredients of this medicine
Lungs
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
While no direct contraindications exist, individuals with pre-existing respiratory conditions should consult their doctor before use.
Heart Disease
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
While no direct contraindications exist, individuals with pre-existing cardiovascular conditions should consult their doctor before use.
Certain B vitamins, when taken in excess, may influence homocysteine levels, which are linked to cardiovascular health.
Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
The safety of NERVMAX ACTIVE Capsule in children is not well studied.
Use only under pediatric supervision if prescribed for nutritional deficiencies or nerve health issues.
Use In Geriatrics
MONITORING REQUIRED
Elderly individuals are more prone to vitamin B12 deficiency and may benefit from this supplement.
Regular monitoring is advised to prevent overdose and ensure safe supplementation.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking CALCULATE D3 ORANGE & MINT FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE CHEWABLE TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone)

Medicines used to control the rate of your heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
Thiazide diuretics (water tablets) Ex. Bendroflumethiazide (used to manage fluid retention)
Calcium supplements
Antacids for indigestion (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Medicine used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole)
Corticosteroids Ex. hydrocortisone or prednisolone (used to manage inflammatory condition)
Laxatives such as paraffin oil (used to manage constipation)
Cholestyramine used to manage high cholesterol
Phosphate binding agents Ex. sevelamer (used to control high levels of phosphorous in the blood)

Symptoms of overdose include hypervitaminosis, hypercalciuria and hypercalcaemia (signs include loss of appetite, thirst, nausea, vomiting, constipation, abdominal pain, muscle weakness, fatigue, mental disturbances, excess thirst or urination, bone pain, nephrocalcinosis, renal calculi and in severe cases it may cause cardiac arrhythmias).

Introduction About TINEP OD TABLET

TINEP OD TABLET contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. TINEP OD TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines. It is also not recommended for use in patients with Leber’s disease (an inherited form of vision loss).

Before taking TINEP OD TABLET, inform your doctor if you are in an occupation of handling mercury and/or have kidney problems (such as renal failure) or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

TINEP OD TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TINEP OD TABLET are weakness, headache, back pain, muscle pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anemia in affected individuals.

Oral Disintegrating Tablet:

Take TINEP OD TABLET as advised by your physician. Place TINEP OD TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Sublingual Tablet:

Take TINEP OD TABLET as advised by your physician. Place TINEP OD TABLET under the tongue till it dissolves. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Colla-2 Tablet is a nutritional supplement used to maintain proper structure, conformation and function of bones and joints. It contains collagen type II, chondroitin sulphate, sodium hyaluronate, and some herbs as active ingredients that help in lowering the pain and enhancing the joint mobility.

Collagen is a protein structure that forms a fibrous network, throughout your body and keeps you in one piece. Chondroitin is required for the cartilage matrix found in joints, which undergoes continuous breakdown and repair.

Sodium hyaluronate acts as a cushion and lubricant in the joints and it might also affect the way the body responds to injury. Rose hip extract exerts immunosuppressive effects and alleviates joint pain. Curcuma has powerful anti-inflammatory effects and is a very strong antioxidant.

Take Colla-2 Tablet as directed by the physician. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About SOFTERON GOLD STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

SOFTERON GOLD Suspension is an iron supplement used to promote red blood cell formation. It contains Iron, Folic acid and L-Lysine as active ingredients.

Iron is essential for growth and development. It helps to produce haemoglobin (a protein in red blood cells that helps to transport oxygen from lungs to all parts of the body). Folic acid also aids in red blood cell production and manages anemia. L-lysine is an amino acid essential for protein synthesis. It helps to absorb iron for the formation of haemoglobin.

Take SOFTERON GOLD Suspension as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Give 2.5 to 5ml once daily for children. For adults take 7.5ml once daily or as directed by the doctor. Not to exceed the recommended daily usage. Consult your doctor before using SOFTERON GOLD Suspension, if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or having any medical conditions.

Oosure Tablet is a nutritional supplement used to manage Polycystic Ovary syndrome (PCOS). It can also be used in the management of diabetes, heart disease, metabolic syndrome, and psychiatric disorders such as anxiety, depression etc. It contains Myo-inositol as an active ingredient that helps enhance female reproductive health.

Myo-inositol works by improving insulin resistance, lowering triglyceride levels, decreasing blood pressure and improving blood sugar levels.

Always take Oosure Tablet as directed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Before taking Oosure Tablet, inform your doctor in case you are pregnant, planning for pregnancy or breastfeeding.

name: Nutrobril Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About NUTROBRIL TABLET

Nutrobril Tablet is a dietary supplement used to protect the skin from free radicals (waste products of the body that damages the body cells). It contains glutathione, vitamin C, alpha lipoic acid, grape seed extract, licorice extract, vitamin E, and vitamin B3 as active ingredients that help in skin nourishment.

Glutathione works by stimulating the production of lighter melanin pigment (pheomelanin) over its darker counterpart (eumelanin), effectively lightening the skin and helping to boost immunity, stamina and detoxification.

Vitamin C and grape seed are antioxidants used to protect your body's cells from damage. Alpha lipoic acid increases the body’s ability to produce glutathione, converts in-active glutathione to its active form and works in synergy with glutathione.

Licorice demonstrates potent anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects. Vitamin B3 helps protect skin cells from sun damage. Vitamin E restores skin moisture and slows down the ageing of skin cells.

Take Nutrobril Tablet as advised by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children, and people with other medical conditions should consult their doctor before taking it.

name: AZKERA Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About AZKERA TABLET

Azkera Tablet is a hair supplement used to restore lost hair and maintain general hair health. It contains keratin, collagen, zinc, vitamins and minerals as active ingredients which are essential for the growth and maintenance of healthy hair.

Keratin leaves the hair smooth and adds shine to the hair by smoothing down the cells which overlap to form the hair strands. Collagen is rich in amino acids that is needed by the body to build keratin. Zinc inhibits hair follicle regression, and it accelerates hair follicle recovery.

Borage oil is effective against scleroderma (a disease of connective tissue which also causes hair fall) and controls hair loss. Inositol is essential to regulate metabolism and growth and helps to spur hair growth and manage balding.

Vitamins and minerals are major elements in the normal hair follicle cycle as they play a role in cellular turnover (rapidly dividing cells in the follicle bulb). Grapeseed extract contains linolenic acid which is one of the essential fatty acid necessary for a healthy scalp. It also moisturises the scalp without making it oily.

Always take Azkera Tablet exactly as advised by your physician. Do not take more than recommended daily dose. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About RETIHERB CAPSULE

Retiherb Capsule is a dietary nutritional supplement that is used to manage retinal damage in patients with age-related macular degeneration (an eye diseases leading to blurred central vision). It contains lutein, omega-3-fatty acids, and zeaxanthin as active ingredients that work together to improve visual functions.

Omega-3 fatty acids help regulate blood vessel growth in our eyes which gets abnormal in age-related macular degeneration. They are also important for retina and light and dark perception. Lutein and zeaxanthin are carotenoids that help in filtering the harmful blue light that can damage the rods and cones (cells in the eyes), thus protecting the retina and reducing the risk of disease progression.

Always take Retiherb Capsule as advised by your doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Before taking Retiherb Capsule, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing conditions or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Introduction About ARGIGOLD 1000MG TABLET

Argigold Tablet is a protein supplement that helps to improve amniotic fluid index in pregnant women with oligohydramnios (too little amniotic fluid). It is also used to manage or manage eclampsia (high blood pressure and protein in urine) during pregnancy. It contains L-Arginine as an active ingredient.

L-Arginine promotes the intrauterine growth of the unborn baby by increasing bioavailability of nutrients and improves the umbilical artery blood flow in pregnancy induced high blood pressure and fetal growth restriction. It works by improving amniotic fluid, allowing fetal lung maturation and improves the outcome of the pregnancy.

Take Argigold Tablet as advised by your doctor. Swallow the tablet with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the tablet. Take 1-2 tablets daily after a meal or as directed by the doctor.

I MEG 3 Softgel Capsule is a dietary supplement used to improve eye health, control pressure in the eyes and reduces the risk of age-related decline in vision. It contains Astaxanthin, Zeaxanthin, Lutein and Omega-3-fatty acids, as active ingredients.

Lutein, Astaxanthin and Zeaxanthin are powerful antioxidants that are proven to protect your eyes from age-related macular degeneration (blurring of vision caused due to aging). They work by managing damage to the eye cells and improves their span which helps in managing vision problems. Omega-3-fatty acids controls pressure within the eyes and keeps your eyes lubricated which alleviates the signs of ocular hypertension, glaucoma and dry eyes.

introduction:
Introduction About GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET

GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

How GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET Works

GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. This active form helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine, retain calcium in the kidneys, and release calcium from bones. It also supports the immune system by affecting immune cells and reducing inflammation.

How to use GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET

Take GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET as advised by your physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

For Tablets, Capsules and softgels: Swallow GEN D3 NANO CHEWABLE TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Orally Disintegrating tablet/strips and chewable tablet: Place the medicine beneath the tongue and allow it to dissolve on its own.

Introduction About XTRACAL HD TABLET

Xtracal HD Tablet is a nutritional supplement used to manage calcium deficiency in conditions like osteoporosis (bone loss), osteomalacia or rickets (weak bones), hypoparathyroidism, pregnancy or breastfeeding.

It contains calcium and vitamin D3 as active ingredients that help meet up the calcium requirements of the body when the dietary intake is not sufficient.

Calcium is essential for many normal functions of body mainly, bone formation and maintenance. Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) helps the body to increase the intestinal absorption of calcium.

Always take Xtracal HD Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. Before taking it, inform your doctor if you have high levels of calcium or vitamin D in your blood, or any heart, kidney, liver, immune, bowel or stomach disease. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About BECOSULES PLUS CAPSULE

Becosules Plus is a nutritional supplement used to manage vitamin and mineral deficiencies which may be associated with unbalanced diet, infections, disease recovery, or old age. It contains vitamins and minerals as active ingredients which are necessary for maintenance or improvement of various bodily functions.

Vitamin A is an essential nutrient for eyesight, immunity, and reproduction. Vitamin D, vitamin C, and calcium are required for the bone, cartilage, muscle, and teeth health. Vitamin B complex strengthens nerves, produces energy and metabolizes protein. Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant and helps maintain the integrity of the blood vessels.

Folic acid and Copper are essential for formation of red blood cells and DNA. Manganese and Zinc is involved in synthesis and degradation of carbohydrates, fats, proteins, and nucleic acids. Zinc is also important for normal growth, wound healing, and sexual maturation.

Iodine plays a role in the making of thyroid hormones. Magnesium is involved in maintenance of the electrical potential of nervous tissues, cell membrane stabilizing action and muscle contraction.

Take one Becosules Plus capsule per day or as directed by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have liver, stomach or bowel problems (Ex. ulcer, colitis), or if you use or abuse alcohol.

introduction:
Introduction About OBEPPARALPHA CAPSULE

Obepparalpha Capsule is a novel and safer approach for maintaining body mass. It contains Oleoylethanolamide, Pantethine, and Valine as active ingredients. It is used in Metabolic Syndromes including obesity management resulting in weight loss and weight maintenance. It is also indicated in obese patients with NAFLD due to weight loss properties.

Obepparalpha works by modulating the β-oxidation of fats and reducing de-novo lipogenesis. Further, it regulates many co-factors involved in obesity like inducing satiety which leads to a fed state scenario (so there is no excessive dietary fat), attenuating the liver inflammatory cytokines (making the condition less severe and inhibiting cholesterol synthesis) which is the main complication in obesity-related cardiovascular disease.

Always take Obepparalpha Capsule as advised by your healthcare professionals. Take one Capsule in a day or as advised by the health care professionals. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage of Obepparalpha Capsule. Do not take if you are allergic to any of its components.

introduction:
Introduction About FOPYMIN

FoPyMin Tablet is a dietary supplement used to reduce the risk of pregnancy complications and birth defects. It contains methylcobalamin, pyridoxine hydrochloride and folic acid as active ingredients that take part in the metabolism of homocysteine (amino acid whose disturbance of metabolism has been associated with foetal neural tube defect).

Folic acid provides finished folate which the body can immediately use without any kind of metabolism. Methylcobalamin is important for the synthesis of DNA and helps manage neural tube defects. Pyridoxine helps in formation of red blood cells and also reduces morning sickness during pregnancy.

Always take FoPyMin Tablet as advised by your physician. Inform your doctor if you have certain blood disorders (Ex. pernicious anemia, other anaemias), or if you are using marijuana. Limit alcohol intake and do not drive, use machinery, or do anything that needs alertness until you can do it safely.

Side Effects Of FOPYMIN

introduction:
Introduction About UBINEXT PLUS SACHET

Ubinext Plus Sugar Free Sachet is a dietary supplement used in the management of oligozoospermia (low sperm count), asthenozoopermia (reduced sperm movement), and teratozoospermia (abnormal sperms). It is also used for optimizing DNA quality and testis surgery before reproductive techniques to increase sperm count, movement, and quality. Ubinext Plus Sugar Free Sachet contains astaxanthin, coenzyme Q10, zinc, folic acid, l-carnitine and lycopene as active ingredients.

Coenzyme Q10, L-Carnitine helps to provide energy to the sperm for motility. Coenzyme Q10, Lycopene, L-Carnitine, Astaxanthin acts as antioxidant and helps to protect the sperm from oxidative damage. Thus, helps to improve sperm count, motility and quality.

Zinc and folic acid boosts sperm count, motility and viability. Zinc acts as an antioxidant that protects against oxidative stress and is required for energy production. Zinc is also essential for testosterone production, which increases fertility and sex drive.

Always take Ubinext Plus Sugar Free Sachet as advised by your doctor. It is for oral use only. Do not exceed the intake of Ubinext Plus Sugar Free Sachet beyond the daily recommended dosage. Not recommended for use in children.

introduction:
Introduction About VISYNERAL SYRUP

Visyneral Syrup is a nutritional supplement that is used to manage vitamin deficiencies due to loss of appetite, poor eating habits, anorexia after a brief illness, recovery after surgery, or chronic illness.

Visyneral Syrup is also indicated during pregnancy and breastfeeding to maintain maternal health. It contains Multivitamins, Cholecalciferol, and Citrus bioflavonoid as the active ingredients that support the overall well-being of a person.

Vitamins are required in optimum quantities as they support various biological processes. They enhance general health and the immune system and increase the body’s ability to fight infections and diseases. They maintain healthy eyes, and skin protects against illness, strong bones, and teeth.

Cholecalciferol enhances calcium absorption. Citrus bioflavonoids deal with free radicals, improve glucose tolerance and insulin sensitivity and suppress inflammation.

Visyneral Syrup is for oral use only. Take Visyneral Syrup as directed by your doctor, or you can take 1 teaspoonful (approx. 5ml) once daily. Shake the syrup bottle well before every use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage.

name: NERVUP FORTE NEW Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET

NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET contains Alpha Lipoic Acid, Folic Acid, Methyl cobalamin, Pyridoxine, and Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), which belong to the group of medicines called Antioxidants and Vitamin supplements, respectively. It is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (diabetic nerve damage).

NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET is also used for the management of alcoholic neuropathy (damage to the nerves due to excessive alcohol intake), diabetic retinopathy (diabetic eye disease), peripheral neuropathy (weakness, numbness, and pain usually in the hands and feet), degenerative diseases like Parkinson’s disease (a brain disorder that affects movement) and Alzheimer’s disease (a brain disorder that affects memory and thinking), chronic pain, and vitamin deficiency.

NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET is not recommended for use if you have hypercalcaemia (increased levels of calcium levels in the blood), malabsorption syndrome (difficulty absorbing nutrients from the diet), or hypervitaminosis D (increased level of vitamin D in the body). Consult your doctor before taking it.

NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney impairment, kidney stones, or heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET Works

NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET helps to manage neuropathies and supports the health of the brain, where alpha-lipoic acid, an antioxidant, delays or reverses diabetic neuropathy. Folic acid is useful for enhancing nerve conduction velocity in diabetic neuropathy. Methylcobalamin works by producing a compound called myelin, which covers and protects nerve fibers and helps to rejuvenate the damaged nerves. Pyridoxine is an essential nutrient that is required for the metabolism of lipids, carbohydrates, and proteins. It is also needed for the synthesis of neurotransmitters (chemical messengers), and vitamin D increases the level of nerve growth factor (which helps in the development and survival of nerves) by stimulating its production and managing its depletion.
usageDetails:
How to use NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET

Take NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET with a glass of water, and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Others

Folate-dependent cancers

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Isoniazid, amino-salicylic acid, rifampicin (medicines used to manage tuberculosis)
Oral contraceptives (medicines used to manage pregnancy) (Ex. oestradiol valerate)
Levodopa (a medicine used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Penicillamine, neomycin, chloramphenicol, and co-trimoxazole (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Colchicine (used for the management of gout)
Methotrexate (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and cancer)
Medicines used to manage peptic ulcers (Ex. cimetidine, omeprazole, and lansoprazole)
Mercaptopurine (a medicine used for the management of leukemia)
Altretamine (a medicine used to manage ovary cancer)
Antiepileptics (medicines used to manage fits) (Ex. phenytoin, phenobarbital, primidone, carbamazepine)
Sulfasalazine (a medicine used to manage ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease)
Ketoconazole (a medicine used for the management of fungal infections)
Mineral oil
Corticosteroids (medicines used for the management of inflammatory conditions)
Vitamin C supplements
Potassium supplements
Thiazide diuretics (used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases) (Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide)
Calcium or phosphate supplements
Paricalcitol (used to manage hypoparathyroidism)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally uses too much of NERVUP FORTE NEW TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage include loss of appetite, weakness, weight loss, vague aches and stiffness, nausea and vomiting, constipation or diarrhea, polyuria (increased urination), nocturia (frequent urination at night), polydipsia (increased thirst), sweating, headache, somnolence, vertigo, mental retardation, anemia (decreased in red blood cell count) and mild acidosis, hypercalciuria (excess calcium in urine), reversible azotemia (elevation of metabolic products), high blood pressure, nephrocalcinosis (deposition of calcium in the kidneys), generalized vascular calcification (abnormal accumulation of calcium in blood) or irreversible kidney damage which may result in death.

Widespread accumulation of calcium in the heart, blood vessels, renal tubules, and lungs. Bone demineralization (osteoporosis) in adults occurs concomitantly. A decline in the average rate of linear growth and increased mineralization of bones in infants and children (dwarfism) may also occur.
